text: Here are all of my agents, one shared memory system, zero manual task management. Agent one is my CEO. Every single morning at 6am it reviews what got done yesterday, decides what matters today, and then assigns work to the rest of the team. Agent two is the CMO, looks at the top performing content, my competitor angles, and my own past winners, and then turns that into scripts for me to film today. Agent three is the sales rep, checking my inbound leads, follow ups, pipeline stages, and what needs attention. Agent four, the researcher, pulling market context, competitor context, and anything else the other agents need before they make their decisions. Agent five is the data analyst, it looks at the dashboard and ranks what actually matters. The real unlock is the shared knowledge memory system. Every single agent can see what every other agent learned, finished, and flagged. That's what turns this from a bunch of prompts and a bunch of useless AI into an actual operating system.
